definitions.explanation: A region of central Japan facing the Pacific, generally covering Aichi, Gifu, Shizuoka, and Mie prefectures. Centered on Nagoya and named for the historic Tokaido coastal route.

examples.japanese: {東海|とうかい}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in the Tokai region.

examples.japanese: {東海|とうかい}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧だ。
examples.english: The center of the Tokai region is Nagoya.

examples.japanese: {東海|とうかい}{道|どう}⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: The Tokaido Shinkansen connects Tokyo and Osaka.

notes:
{東海|とうかい} covers {愛知|あいち}, {岐阜|ぎふ}, {静岡|しずおか}, and {三重|みえ} prefectures, centered on ⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧. The name comes from the {東海道|とうかいどう}, the historic coastal highway linking ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧ and ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧, and today names the corridor followed by the original {東海道|とうかいどう}⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東海|とうかい}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: the Tokai region
- {東海|とうかい}{道|どう}: the Tokaido (historic route; also the Shinkansen line)
- {東海|とうかい}⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧: a Tokai-region earthquake (a long-anticipated major quake)
